name: Developer Experience Engineer Pack
description: Workflows for DX and platform-product engineers: SDK design, internal tooling, developer documentation, onboarding automation, API ergonomics, and contributor experience.
useCases: Design SDKs and internal tools with ergonomic, stable interfaces.
Write developer documentation, onboarding guides, and API references that contributors can follow.
Automate contributor workflows with CI checks and healthy dependency management.
examplePrompts: Review this SDK's public API for ergonomics and consistency, and propose improvements with migration notes.
Write an onboarding guide for this repository that gets a new contributor to a merged PR.
